profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary: Full stack engineer with 10+ years of experience delivering applications across e-commerce, consumer lending, healthcare, and airline management domains. Highly skilled in micro-frontends and scalable RESTful APIs utilizing C#, Vue, Angular, React, Node.js, Typescript. Driving the end-to-end software development lifecycle from discovery alongside UX and product teams to deployment within event-driven architectures.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed public web portals to support divers, instructors and dive shops on the whole process from learning to certifications and the activities on the diving journeys. Built a Vue design system to provide reusable UI components and headless microservices on the backend. Managed and customized commercetools features, integrated PayPal components, and connected with partner systems to support promotional campaigns. 

Stack: C#, Vue, commercetools, SCSS, Javascript, Angular, C#, AWS and Git

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developing a consumer lending platform which supports customers and agents on the whole processing workflow of loan applications from receiving leads to funding the loan. Writing code for the system from RESTful API backend to web frontend.
Stack: C#, Angular, Typescript, Sql Server and TFS

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed a mobile device cloud that gives developers and testers access to hundreds of real Android and iOS devices to perform both manual and automation testing.  Writing code for various parts of the system including web frontend, desktop frontend and RESTful API backend.
Stack: ES6/7, React, Redux, Radium, Material-UI, Electron, NodeJS, Koa, PostgreSQL, and Git

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed an airline management system with features such as e-ticketing, revenue management, flight operations, crew scheduling, fleet maintenance, human resources, assets management, finance and accounting etc.  Some of our customers include Airblue, Novoair and Ariana Afghan Airlines.
Stack: C#, ASP.NET MVC, Razor, ADO.NET, LINQ-2-SQL, JavaScript, jQuery, PLSQL, CSS, and Git

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed a large e-commerce system (MarketLive).
Stack: Java, Struts, Tiles, JavaScript, jQuery, PL/SQL, XML/XSLT, CSS, and Bronto
